name: school-clinician-tracker
description: Local-first time tracking for school-based clinicians

scripts.build:mac-arm: bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/server.ts --outfile dist/mac-arm/ClinicianTracker && bun run sign:mac dist/mac-arm/ClinicianTracker
scripts.build:mac-intel: bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/server.ts --outfile dist/mac-intel/ClinicianTracker && bun run sign:mac dist/mac-intel/ClinicianTracker
scripts.build:all: bun run build:mac-arm && bun run build:mac-intel && bun run build:windows
